name: Echo of Pli Xin Liako
description: Creates an echo at your current location that applies Echo of Pli Xin Liako Effect to your companions, which increases their attack speed by 25%, spell damage by 33%, triple attack rate by 25%, their chance to flurry by 22%, and their companions' chance to flurry by 28% as long as they stay within earshot of your echo.
